```{r}
#Question 2
# a. 
data(rivers)

length(rivers)
sum(rivers)
mean(rivers)
median(rivers)
var(rivers)
sd(rivers)
min(rivers)
max(rivers)
# b.
river_stats <- c(length = length(rivers), sum = sum(rivers), mean = mean(rivers), median = median(rivers), variance = var(rivers), standard_deviation = sd(rivers), minimum = min(rivers), maximum = max(rivers))
river_stats
```
